name: Aam Digital
project_description: Easy-to-use case management software for the social sector that improves the effectiveness and transparency of work with beneficiaries. The offline-first web app is tailored to be used by NGOs anywhere in the world.
llm_summary: Donate to the social sector with Case Management software for the webThis is an offline, case management software that makes it easy for NGOs to keep track of their work with beneficiaries and improve the efficiency of their operations.

name: AccessMod
project_description: AccessMod is a free, open-source, standalone software to model physically accessibility to health services, to account for shortage of capacity in these services (human or equipment), to measure referral times and distances between health services, and to increase population coverage through scaling up analyses.
llm_summary: This chapter describes the capabilities of AccessMod, a free and open-source software that helps to predict physically accessible health services by adjusting for the availability and demand of health services based on population data.

name: Altinn
project_description: Altinn is a platform for digital dialogue between businesses, private individuals and public agencies.Altinn is also a platform that government bodies can use to develop and host digital services.
llm_summary: Alt is a project of the Estonian government to develop, host and administer a digital services center for information technology in the country. The goal of the center is to be to use the cloud as a basis for developing and hosting such a center, and the government can use it as a means to develop these services.

name: Boxtribute
project_description: An open-source digital system making it easy to rapidly and collaboratively source, store & distribute humanitarian aid to people in need in a fair and dignified way.
llm_summary: This is an open-source, cross-platform project that makes it easy to "relieve, source, store, store and distribute humanitarian aid" quickly and dignified.

name: CityLearn
project_description: CityLearn is an open source OpenAI Gym environment for the implementation of advanced control systems, e.g., MPC, and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (RL) for building energy coordination and demand response in several buildings. CityLearn allows easy implementation agents in a multi-agent setting to reshape their aggregated curve of electrical demand.
llm_summary: OpenAI presents a new control system called CityLearn, which uses machine learning to predict energy demand and respond to it promptly.

name: CKAN
project_description: CKAN is an Open Source Data Management System to build Data Portals. Trusted by hundreds of portals across the world and supported by an active community, it focuses on extensibility and integration with other tools.
llm_summary: Kan is an open source data management system designed to build data portals. It focuses onextensibility and integrated integration with other systems.

name: CodiTeach
project_description: CodiTeach is an innovative web platform for teachers that streamlines account management for schools, classes, and students. Platform provides a royalty-free alternative to costly educational platforms for underfunded schools in impoverished developing countries.
llm_summary: An Indian company called Codetteach develops a teaching platform called CodiTeach. It helps teachers manage their accounts and students and is royalty-free. They provide a free alternative to "expensive educational platforms" for poor countries in which the teachers have to pay for all the textbooks and teachers.

name: CommCare
project_description: CommCare is the digital platform for impactful frontline work everywhere. The most widely-deployed and evidence-based platform for enabling Frontline Workers, CommCare empowers organizations to build their own digital solutions to better deliver services and collect data.
llm_summary: Comm is the name of her new product. It is a suite of services designed to make working life easier for front-line workers and their families, says the company.

name: Creative Commons Legal Tools
project_description: CC legal tools enable the sharing and use of DPGs via standard, international open copyright licenses. CC stewards its open licenses and public domain tools to give every person and organization in the world a free, simple way to share their work in the commons.
llm_summary: DPGs are freely available under the Attribution-ShareAlike license and are licensed under the copyleft CC.org public domain umbrella.

name: Deon
project_description: Deon is a command line tool that allows you to easily add an ethics checklist to your data science projects. We support creating a new, standalone checklist file or appending a checklist to an existing analysis in many common formats.
llm_summary: This chapter introduces Deon, a utility for data science projects that helps to organize and automate an ethics checklist. It is free and open-source and can be installed on any computer.

name: DiCRA
project_description: Data in Climate Resilient Agriculture (DiCRA) is a collaborative geospatial platform which provides open access to key geospatial datasets pertinent to climate resilient agriculture. These datasets are curated and validated through collaborative efforts of a large community of data scientists and citizen scientists across the world. The pattern detection and data insights emerging from DiCRA are aimed towards strengthening evidence-driven policy making for climate resilient food systems.
llm_summary: the authors describe the creation of a new dataset called DiCRA, which will aid policy makers in making evidence-driven decisions about climate-resilient agriculture. They develop the tool to help them better understand land use and trends in order to make better food security decisions

name: DIGIT
project_description: DIGIT is an open-source, configurable, extendable, modular, digital infrastructure that enables local governments to deliver municipal services to citizens in an efficient, inclusive, and transparent manner.
llm_summary: Diggit is a city-wide digital infrastructure that allows local governments to provide municipal services to their citizens "in an efficient, in an inclusive and transparent manner". According to the company, it helps make municipal services more accessible and transparent.

name: ekShop Marketplace
project_description: ekShop marketplace is a robust and adaptable eCommerce platform that is free and open-source. It is designed to cater to the needs of any potential entrepreneur who wants to set up an online store quickly and efficiently. With its customizable and configurable features, ekShop can be tailored to suit your specific requirements.
llm_summary: ekShop Marketplace EkShop, marketplace

name: Ersilia Model Hub
project_description: The Ersilia Model Hub is the only open-source platform serving ready-to-use AI models to accelerate the discovery of new treatments for infectious diseases which affect predominantly the Global South.
llm_summary: Ersilia's contribution to this effort is a very significant one: the Ersilia model hub is an open-source, distributed platform that uses machine learning to predict and accelerate the detection of infectious diseases in the developing world.

name: Feluda
project_description: Feluda is a configurable engine for analysing multi-lingual and multi-modal content. While flexible, it is built it to analyse data collected from social media - images,text and video. It is configurable to allow for different use cases such as finding trends and narratives in social media across languages, and surfacing fact checked content corresponding to image and video.
llm_summary: Feluda is an engine for social media sentiment analysis. It was designed specifically to analyze sentiment in a broad range of languages and to search for, sort, categorize, and sort content by the value of its constituent language.

name: Go.Data
project_description: Go.Data is an open-source platform for outbreak response and contact tracing developed by WHO in collaboration with GOARN partners. It streamlines all aspects of outbreak response and is highly versatile with customizable configurations for different scenarios.
llm_summary: WHO has developed an application called Go.Data that helps to control outbreak response activities by tracking contact tracing and disease outbreaks over time. It is very versatile and can be adapted to meet changing needs.

name: Harmony
project_description: Harmony is an open-source, end-to end data integration and advanced analytics platform for integrating, harmonizing, analyzing, and visualizing any number of structured data sources from different sectors (e.g. health, education, agriculture, sustainable development, climate change adaptation), ranging from routinely collected individual level data to operational research and survey data.
llm_summary: The Harmony platform for data integration and analytics uses data from many different structured data sources to integrate, harmonize, and visualize information.

name: Health Claims Data Exchange
project_description: The HCX Platform by Swasth Alliance enables seamless health claims data exchange with tools like SDKs, management apps, and an exchange switchƒ??boosting collaboration and interoperability across the health ecosystem.
llm_summary: Swasth Alliance's HCX Platform enables seamless health insurance claims data exchange. It also enables third-party vendors to integrate their claims data into a single platform.

name: HOPE
project_description: HOPE is UNICEFƒ??s humanitarian cash transfer management information system. HOPE allows to register and target beneficaries, track approval of payment list send them to payment providers, process reconciliation and payment verification and facilitate grievances and feedbacks.
llm_summary: Here's a sample of what's new with HOPE: cash transfer information system. UNICEF has invented a new program called HOPE. It's supposed to be able to track and manage cash flow in the coming humanitarian crisis really quickly and efficiently.

name: IASO
project_description: IASO is an innovative, open-source, bilingual (EN/FR) data collection platform with advanced geospatial features to plan, monitor and evaluate health, environmental or social programmes. Main features: geo-enabled data collection, georegistry, microplanning, entities & workflows.
llm_summary: Asiaso is an open-source geospatial data collection platform designed to help governments better understand and monitor "health, environment or social programmes". Its main features are "geographic-enabled data capture, geomorphology, geographie, geography, and analysis.

name: Isomer
project_description: Isomer is a website builder that allows government agencies to launch static websites easily and for free. It aims to empower the government to easily and effectively communicate with citizens while enabling citizens to easily find the information they are looking for.
llm_summary: Is is a company that creates static websites for government and sells to the public. In fact, all of its business is in the domain name itself. The company's mission is to help government communicate with the people and to make them easily find the things they want to know. For example, when I went to visit my dentist, the receptionist told me there was no one there. When I asked if there was someone there to help me, he said no.

name: Jellow AAC Communicator
project_description: Jellow Basic Communicator is a freely downloadable friendly Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) system that uses icons/images to enable aid communication in people learning to speak or with difficulty with speech and language.
llm_summary: This is a free downloadable friendly AAC/AAC-compatible tool that uses icons and images to aid communication between people who have speech and language impairments.Jellow's Journal is a companion to his Jell Basic Communicator, a text-to-speech system

name: La Suite Meet
project_description: Powered by LiveKit, La Suite Meet is a video conference software that offers Zoom-level performance with high-quality video and audio. No installation requiredƒ??simply join calls directly from your browser.
llm_summary: La, it is a real live call waiting for you in your phone. No installation is required, and you can simply join calls from anywhere in the world.

name: Marine Spatial Planning - SAHAV
project_description: MSP-SAHAV is an open software used for planning sea spaces that can help visualize and communicate complex spatial information, supporting informed decision-making and the process of organizing and managing human activities in marine areas across space and time.
llm_summary: This is an open source software that helps to visualize and communicate "complex spatial information" in order to make informed decisions. It is a planning software for planning seaports.

name: Oobee
project_description: Oobee (formerly known as Purple A11y) is a customisable, automated accessibility testing tool that allows software development teams to find and fix accessibility problems, to improve access to digital services for the elderly and Persons with Disabilities (PWDs).
llm_summary: The company develops a tool called Oobee to help developers test their software for accessibility features. It's also called an accessibility testing tool because it uses machine learning to predict problems that are hidden in older and disabled people's code.

name: Open Contracting Portal
project_description: The Open Contracting Portal (OC Portal) is an open-source platform built to organize and archive procurement documents, improve data transparency and feedback by the public, and help publish procurement information in the Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS)
llm_summary: An open-source project designed to organize, archive, and publish procurement documents. Its goal is to improve the transparency and accountability in the contracting process by making it easier for the public to understand and participate in government contracts.

name: Open Data Editor
project_description: Open Data Editor (ODE) is a free, open-source desktop app designed to help nonprofits, data journalists, activists, and public servants detect errors in their datasets. It is designed for people working with tabular data (Excel, Google Sheets, CSV) who don't know how to code.
llm_summary: This tutorial describes and describes Open Data Editor, a free and open-source application that helps people make sense of data. It is especially good for people who want to help with datasets but don't know code.

name: Open-Pryv.io
project_description: Personal Data & Privacy Management Software, A ready-to-use solution for personal data and consent management.Pryv.io is a solid foundation on which you build your own digital health solution, so you can collect, store, share and rightfully use personal data.
llm_summary: Pryvio is a complete solution for "personal data and privacy management software." It's the perfect starting point for anyone who wants to build their own "digital health" solution.

name: OpenFn
project_description: OpenFn is a workflow automation platform that's used to automate & integrate critical business processes and systems. From last-mile services to national-level reporting, it boosts efficiency & effectiveness while enabling secure, stable, scalable interoperability at all levels.
llm_summary: The company describes its new workflow automation platform, OpenFn, as a "critical business process and systems" that can help enterprises manage their IT infrastructure. It boosts efficiency and effectiveness while enabling interoperability at multiple levels.

name: OpenMRS
project_description: OpenMRS is a collaborative open-source project to develop software to support the delivery of health care in developing countries. OpenMRS is founded on the principles of openness and sharing of ideas, software and strategies for deployment and use.
llm_summary: In this short paper, Dr. Barlow explains the intent of OpenMRS, a project to develop open-source software to aid in the delivery of quality health care in poor countries. He emphasizes the importance of information sharing and the value of experimentation in order to gain insights from experience.

name: OpenSPP
project_description: OpenSPP is an integrated and digital social protection information system that enables governments and humanitarian agencies to streamline the creation and management of assistance programs.
llm_summary: OpenSPP, a new generation of information systems that helps governments, aid agencies, and private companies, to more easily manage and track their activities.

name: Register for Organic Agriculture
project_description: ROA is an innovative software tool designed to simplify the record-keeping process for farmers and agribusinesses, ensuring compliance with organic standards and EU Regulation 2018/848 for organic agriculture.
llm_summary: Roa is an agricultural record-keeping software tool that helps businesses keep track of their organic acres and ensure compliance with EU regulations.

name: Rural Environmental Registry Registration Module
project_description: The Rural Environmental Registry (RER) is a solution for managing declared geospatial environmental information on rural properties to serve as a database for control, monitoring, environmental and economic planning.
llm_summary: Rivers publishes a Geographic information on land use and uses it as a resource for planning and control. The goal of the registry is to create a single source of information for all aspects of the environment affecting rural America

name: Safe YOU
project_description: Safe YOU is an innovative technological solution created to reduce gender-based violence through a mobile application and multifunctional web platform which work to streamline prevention programmes and ensure safety and access to resources for all women and girls.
llm_summary: Safe You is an innovative technology solution that helps reduce gender- based violence by providing women with information about how to prevent and report incidents of violence

name: Sunbird RC
project_description: ƒ??Sunbird Registry and Credentialƒ? or simply ƒ??Sunbird RCƒ? is an open source software to rapidly build and deploy next generation electronic registries and verifiable credentials including attestation and verification flows.
llm_summary: The Sunbird registry and credential manager, or simply Sunbird RC as it is called, is an open-source software that allows developers to build and deploy "next generation Electronic Registries and Verifiable Credential Management Systems" using a single line of code.
